_comment: Orion release manifest consumed by OrionSetup.exe. Ships next to the exe (and is embedded as a resource fallback). REPLACE every 'url' with the real release-host URL (must be https://) and every 'sha256' with the real lowercase-hex SHA-256 of that exact file. size_bytes drives the meter total (sum of downloadable components = 305 MB here); size_text is what the checklist shows. A sha256 of 64 zeros is a DEV-ONLY placeholder that skips verification — do NOT ship to end users with placeholder hashes. Set "production": true (below) or build with -DORION_REQUIRE_VERIFIED to make placeholder hashes ABORT the install instead of being skipped.
